title: Academic case reports lack diversity: Assessing the presence and diversity of sociodemographic and behavioral factors related to Post COVID-19 Condition

bias_targets.methodology: Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract age-related mentions and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to evaluate entailment and contradiction rates for statements such as 'Is a senior adult (>65)' in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract gender-related mentions and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to evaluate entailment and contradiction rates for statements such as 'Is female-identifying' in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract race and ethnicity mentions and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to evaluate entailment and contradiction rates for statements such as 'Is white/caucasian' to measure the representation of different racial groups in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to analyze the frequency and representation of attributes like housing status, medical insurance, income levels, employment, and access to care in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract sexual orientation mentions and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to evaluate entailment and contradiction rates for statements such as 'Is heterosexual' in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract spiritual belief mentions and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to evaluate entailment and contradiction rates for statements such as 'Is christian or catholic' in medical case reports.

Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Natural Language Inference (NLI) to analyze language dominance by checking the entailment and contradiction rates of statements like 'English is their primary language' in medical case reports.
